items.title: Master tender register spreadsheet
items.question: We think the master tender register is '1. Lobos_Tender Schedule_2024-2025_LIVE - 24_04_26.xlsx' in 02_3 Tenders - Estimates & Quotes (2026) / 00_Tender Register & Procedure (last changed 19 May 2026, about 1,624 rows). The older copy in 02_2 (2025) / 1. ESTIMATING PROCESS stopped at 19 Dec 2025. Is that right? Neither has changed since mid-May - is there a newer register somewhere?
items.need: Yes / no (and where the newer one is, if any), and upload the '2024 - 2025 - Tender Register' sheet exported as CSV (File > Save As > CSV). Our document reader can't see past row 866.

items.title: Contract values to confirm (8 jobs)
items.question: From the documents we found: Swissotel $169,000 lump sum (Chroma contract SCS00227, 12 Mar 26). Football ID - Gregory Hills $7,150 (DNP PO-0465, matches quote 26_169 R3). Vaucluse - Old South Head Rd $435,930 incl. variations (progress claim 16; main works $195,780 on the claim vs $195,880 on quote 24_414 R6). Thales Zone 4 $96,064 (subcontract 'for signing' copy - was it signed at this price? quote 26_273 Rev C was $116,850). Shellharbour WH1 $74,900.01 (quote 26_120 Rev 1) plus variation V02 $23,738.10 - your 9 Oct forecast says $108,268.11 in total. Rivkin House $55,900 (quote 26_419 R2; options $14,400 and $6,768) - accepted, and were any options taken? Bronte - do-and-charge at $75/hr, no fixed value? 2 Roslyn St - $25,000 schedule of rates, now billed as monthly day labour - treat as do-and-charge?
items.need: For each: the value to use (ex GST), or 'do-and-charge'.
items.why: Without a contract value the Directors screen shows these jobs as 'can't assess'.

items.title: Bellevue Hill - which project folder?
items.question: Bellevue Hill (quote 24_459 Rev01) has two live project folders: 24_091 (holds the quote) and 24_094. Operations uses 24_094. Which is the real project number?
items.why: Every app now uses one job number per job.

items.title: Rooster's day rate
items.question: Rooster (Jeao Ineson) is now billed through Example Consultants. Operations uses $470/day, but that is an estimate from one invoice ($2,362.50 for 5 days). When he came through Project 71 (Jan-May 2026) he was $577-$600/day. What is the agreed rate now?
items.need: The day rate ex GST and from when.
items.why: His labour cost is currently marked unconfirmed.

items.title: How are invoices tagged by job in Xero?
items.question: When you raise a client invoice or progress claim in Xero, how is it tied to the job? For example a tracking category (what is it called?), the job number in the reference, Xero Projects, or not tied at all.
items.need: A short answer, plus one real export of each: the sales invoices list (CSV) and the monthly Profit & Loss (Excel). Bills list and Aged Receivables too if easy.
items.why: So the Directors screen can show revenue and profit per job from Xero.
